cases.user_job: Understand one answer and continue the conversation.
cases.why: A reusable container would add retrieval and editing ceremony without improving this immediate answer.
cases.avoid: Do not turn a normal reply into an artifact or writing block.

cases.user_job: Edit, copy, send, post, or reuse a finished piece of writing.
cases.why: The native editable block makes the finished prose directly usable without creating a separate document.
cases.avoid: Do not use the block for explanations, plans, code, or unfinished thinking.

cases.user_job: Retrieve and progressively explore a strategy, research brief, audit, or playbook.
cases.why: A durable artifact preserves authority and depth while the decision table shortens the first reading pass.
cases.avoid: Do not duplicate the artifact as slides, a dashboard, and a writing block.

cases.user_job: Keep operator and Codex aligned across dependencies, loops, gates, and state changes.
cases.why: The artifact preserves detail while the flow externalizes the shared execution state that keeps work on track.
cases.avoid: Do not draw a flow for a simple linear list with no branch, loop, gate, or state change.

cases.user_job: Calculate, compare, filter, or inspect real rows and trends.
cases.why: The spreadsheet keeps the numbers inspectable and the chart earns its place only when comparison or change is real.
cases.avoid: Do not create a chart from invented, flat, or non-comparable numbers.

cases.user_job: Deliver a sequenced visual story to an audience.
cases.why: Slides are justified when pacing, audience delivery, and the sequence of visual reveals are part of the outcome.
cases.avoid: Do not turn an internal memo or simple list into a deck.

cases.user_job: Inspect changing status or act through several linked controls and views.
cases.why: A live surface is useful only when state changes or controls make a static artifact materially weaker.
cases.avoid: Do not build a dashboard for a static document.

cases.user_job: Understand or create composition, mood, form, spatial relationships, or visual identity.
cases.why: The concept is inherently visual, so an image communicates what additional prose cannot efficiently embody.
cases.avoid: Do not replace nuanced reasoning with a decorative image.
